images.filename: Venezia - Hotel San Fantin (1870) - Foto Giovanni Dall'Orto, 6-Aug-2007 - 09.jpg
images.caption: Decree dated april 2 1849 concerning the decision by the Republic of Venice not to surrender to the Austrian troops and to keep fighting until the last. It stands on the facade of Hotel San Fantin in Venice (next to the Teatro La Fenice Opera House), which displays on its facade weapons from the 1848-1849 Revolution, and patriottic reliefs related with it. It was built in 1870. Picture by Giovanni Dall'Orto, August 3, 2007.
